notes.title: Red Wake Carnage is now available for purchase!
notes.content:
Hey All:

Red Wake Carnage is now available for purchase:

http://store.steampowered.com/app/656610/?snr=1_5_9__205

Generally speaking game have two modes:

- Expedition mode - this is hunt or be hunted experience, where the enemy will try to sneak on you and run into wilderness as soon as you notice his presence. 

- Slaughter house - this is survival mode which is similar to Dinosaur Hunt game for players expecting more of a Dinosaur Hunt type of game. 

if you are interested in requesting custom achievement to feature on your profile, use this thread:

http://steamcommunity.com/app/656610/discussions/0/1474221865184642335/

I hope you will enjoy it!

Thank you for your support!

ANPA.US

notes.title: Update #3
notes.content:
Hey All:

The custom achievements topic is still open, so you can still have custom descriptions + pictures for your achievements if you'd like that. 

This update is big and brings following changes:

- sounds effects - reworked sound effects for mechs and environment

- map - reworked map and graphics and post processing effects

- removed maps that were bad and focused on one map 

- reworked hitboxes and colliders

- new mech type - crawler

- co-op online mode

- reworked day-night system with weather effects

- options - options are now more conveniently available directly in-game

- lots of bugs squished

If you'd like to play coop mode with me, just add me on steam and we'll give it a go

+ HOTFIX for 3 bugs in achievements.

Thank you 

ANPA.US
